description: React component implementing an infinite scrolling calendar with month navigation, expansion toggle, and date selection handling.

classes.name: InfiniteCalendar
classes.description: React forwardRef component providing an infinitely scrollable calendar with month navigation and date selection.

methods.name: goToMonth
methods.description: Navigates the calendar to the specified month, inserting it if not already loaded.

methods.name: resetNumberOfCalendarsToBase
methods.description: Resets the calendar view to center on a specific date with minimal months loaded.

methods.name: toggleVisibility
methods.description: Expands or collapses the calendar view.

methods.name: elementIdForMonth
methods.description: Generates a DOM element ID string for a given month date.

methods.name: handleDaySelection
methods.description: Handles user selecting a day, resetting calendar months and invoking callback.
